content: EARS (Mavin 2009): Ubiquitous 'The <sys> shall <resp>'; Event 'When <trigger>, the <sys> shall'; State 'While <state>, the <sys> shall'; Unwanted 'If <trigger>, then the <sys> shall'; Optional 'Where <feature>, the <sys> shall'; Complex 'While..., When..., the <sys> shall'. Rules: zero+ preconditions, zero/one trigger, exactly one system name, one+ responses, fixed clause order, mandatory shall. No established npm EARS linter exists; Spec Kit issue #1356 requests EARS; Kiro uses EARS in requirements.md.
